summary: Work is complete and green; the user reviews and commits. Tests whether the handoff reports 'done, waiting on the user' rather than inventing new work.

facts.fact: Goal: retry on HTTP 429 with Retry-After support, so GitHub links aren't marked broken.
The implementation is complete but uncommitted; tests, ruff, and mypy are all green.
Evidence command: uv run pytest -q, which gives 9 passed (plus ruff check and mypy src).
Next step belongs to the user: they review the diff and commit it themselves. The agent shouldn't commit or start new work.
Design: retry only on 429, at most 3 retries, Retry-After capped at 30s, injectable sleep.
Deferred: Retry-After in HTTP-date form isn't handled (float() raises on it).
